plan_ref: planning/steward-chamber-2026-08-09/IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md :: Wave 9 (C11 - tile-affordance functional inventory + parity map, landed BEFORE STATUS is called complete)
law: Every functional affordance the bottom run tiles carry (log links, kill control, historical runs, raw output and the rest) is REGISTERED here as a row grounding itself in a SOURCE marker that still exists in the tile code, and every row RESOLVES: an 'equivalent' row names a LIVE rail/STATUS (or surviving-surface) target marker that must still exist in code; a 'proposed-equivalent' or 'proposed-loss' row carries the decision material John rules on at the W12 signing. The CI gate (chamber_status_overlay.tile_affordance_problems, exercised by tests/test_chamber_close_ci_w9.py) fails by name on a stale source marker, a dead equivalent claim, or an undecided row - a living registry, never a Phase-0 snapshot.
signing_law: W12 tile retirement may ONLY execute against this map once John signs it (C11): every row resolved to a live rail/STATUS equivalent or a John-signed accepted loss, and rail+STATUS parity SIGNED - no tile code is deleted before the signature. This artifact lands in W9 UNSIGNED (signed_by_john: false); W12 records the signature.

rows.affordance: Page-level ambient runs line - glance the live/finished run states without opening anything

parity.note: The M1 progress strip's run-now line carries the same glance state inside the Seal; the STATUS overlay adds the latest captured status table on demand.

rows.affordance: Per-run steward report read on the tile's Report expander (say / needs / recommendation)

parity.note: A done rail step carries its R-YIELD-LINE one-line yield plus the report link into the existing /report viewer, which serves the full steward read.

rows.affordance: Historical finished-runs access in completion order, including each run's earlier/prior reports

parity.note: Every completed step stands permanently on the rail as a done fstep with its yield + report link; the run records themselves persist in the project sidecar regardless of any surface.

rows.affordance: One-click full session transcript (the log link into the traversal-safe /artifact route)

parity.note: The transcript is PERSISTED in the project (general/<session>-transcript.md) and stays reachable through the existing traversal-safe /artifact route independent of any tile. PROPOSAL for the W12 signing: surface a transcript link on the rail runcard's links row; if John declines, he signs the absent link as an accepted loss - the data itself is never lost.

rows.affordance: Open the live session panel from a run tile (raw PTY output / direct terminal access)

parity.note: The rail runcard's session ▸ link opens the SAME session panel (openPanel); the session-panel surface itself is not a bottom tile and is not retired by W12.

rows.affordance: Kill control - Kill → Boneyard on the session panel the tile opens

parity.note: The kill lives on the session panel (a surviving surface, not a bottom tile); post-retirement it is reached via the rail runcard's session ▸ link instead of a tile's Open-the-session button. No kill capability is lost.

rows.affordance: Dismiss a finished run tile from the fold (presentation-only; the run record stays)

parity.note: The rail is state-derived: done steps fold into the flow and the STATUS overlay lists only what remains, so there is nothing to dismiss. PROPOSED ACCEPTED LOSS for John's W12 signature - the affordance was presentation-only and destroyed no data.

rows.affordance: 'Hand it back' / 'Keep watching' re-arm on an asked/quiet/timeout run tile (commission_watch)

parity.note: W10's serialized decision-gate queue renders asked/died/quiet runs as head cards whose resolve re-arms through the SAME commission_watch seam - the drawn card replaces the tile button. To be verified against the landed W10 queue at the W12 signing; until then the tile control stands (no tile is removed before the signature).
